lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in a semi-rectilinear grid across the mid-flank, extending from the posterior gill region toward the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating a defined grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the central lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a high-contrast luminance gradient featuring sharp highlights on the dorsal edge and distinct shadowing on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a dense concentration of smaller high-luminance blobs on its dorsal surface, which decrease in diameter toward the distal tip.
